summary_zh: 越南與歐洲自由貿易聯盟（EFTA）於10月18日簽署自貿協定，涵蓋關稅、服務與投資，關稅調整對出口成本與接單策略的影響持續升溫。同時胡志明市舉辦機電業綠色轉型研討會，減碳合規成為華商製造業新增痛點，經營與ESG部門需及早因應。
summary_en: Vietnam signed an FTA with EFTA on Oct 18 covering tariffs, services and investment, keeping tariff-driven export cost and order strategy concerns rising. A HCMC seminar on green transformation in the mechanical-electrical sector flags carbon compliance as a new pain for Chinese-owned manufacturers.
